study_design: Prospective population-based cohort study of UK Biobank participants.
cohort_total_n_excerpt: 253,138 eligible UK Biobank participants were included in our study.
reason: The study examined incident overall and site-specific cancers in an initially cancer-free prospective cohort. The prostate cancer endpoint was overall incident prostate cancer; the abstract did not analyze an aggressive, advanced, high-grade, metastatic, or lethal prostate cancer subtype.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Only one site-specific cancer, prostate cancer, was associated with omega-3% (HR per SD = 1.03, 95% CI = 1.01 – 1.05, corrected p = 0.049) but not omega-6% (HR per SD = 1.01, 95% CI = 0.98 – 1.03, corrected p = 0.56).
estimate_classifications.reason: The supplied full-text evidence identifies the omega-6 estimate as an overall incident prostate cancer result. It is not an aggressive prostate cancer estimate.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Of the 19 site-specific cancers available, 14 were associated with omega-6% and five with omega-3%, all indicating inverse associations, with the exception that prostate cancer was positively associated with omega-3% (HR per SD = 1.03, 95% CI = 1.01 - 1.05).
estimate_classifications.reason: This is an overall incident prostate cancer estimate per SD of plasma omega-3 percentage, not an aggressive subtype estimate.
